mission: We systematically decode, validate, and translate traditional medical knowledge into scientifically rigorous, AI-enabled therapeutic innovations that address complex diseases and advance global healthcare.

objectives.title: Transform Knowledge into Data
objectives.text: Convert centuries of empirical traditional medicine into a data-driven, mechanism-informed discovery framework by embedding AI and ML across the full continuum of drug discovery.

objectives.title: Build Interdisciplinary Platforms
objectives.text: Unite traditional medicine experts, chemists, biologists, clinicians, engineers, and data scientists around shared scientific questions to address complex, multifactorial diseases.

objectives.title: Accelerate Discovery
objectives.text: Reduce uncertainty and improve reproducibility in early-stage therapeutic research through systematic validation and AI-driven hypothesis generation.

objectives.title: Ensure Ethical Impact
objectives.text: Prioritize affordable, safe, and sustainable therapeutic strategies with transparent, reproducible, and equitable benefit-sharing while stewarding traditional knowledge responsibly.

objectives.title: Inform Global Health Policy
objectives.text: Generate evidence that informs policy, regulation, and clinical translation aligned with national priorities and global health frameworks.

objectives.title: Establish Global Leadership
objectives.text: Position IIT Bombay as the global reference point for AI-enabled, evidence-based traditional medicine research with enduring scientific platforms and translational outcomes.

closingStatement: Through sustained institutional investment, open yet secure scientific infrastructure, and the training of interdisciplinary talent, we are building scientific systems that transform traditional medicine from largely empirical practice into a rigorous, data-driven discovery framework—accelerating innovation while maintaining ethical stewardship and ensuring equitable global health impact.
